thread:
alex: Quick sync: I'm prototyping a "per-model econ" card for the cost dashboard that surfaces token-level unit cost + net cache savings by model family. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/console/pulls/611. Need opinions on the math & UX.

rachel: love the idea. will the card show both estimated savings (modelled) and *billed* savings (what actually shows on invoices)?

alex: plan is two columns: "estimated (heuristic)" and "attributed (billing-backed)". estimated uses our prefetch KV lineage + sample-based weighting, attributed uses post-aggregation reconciled credits.

diego: for the heuristic side, please ensure we normalize per-sequence-length and prompt-shape. otherwise modelA will look better simply because customers send shorter prompts to it.

meera: UX thought: group by model family (modelA, modelA-quant, modelB) with an expand arrow to show variants. users can toggle to view either token-equivalent or USD microcost.

infra-bot: scheduled job: infra.metrics.sample_rates recalculation will run at 03:00 UTC nightly.

rachel: about the sample-based weighting: what sample rate are we using? historical dashboards are noisy at 0.5% for low-volume tenants.

alex: default historical sample = 1%, realtime previews 5%. we also support adaptive sampling that increases sample rate for tenant windows < 500 calls/day.

diego: algorithm note: we should avoid last-touch-only crediting for long chains. propose a hybrid: last-touch up to 1s after prefetch hit, else even-split across touched routes. reduces weirdness when routing defers to fallback long after prefetch.

meera: can we expose the heuristic as part of the UI? e.g., a small footer line: "heuristic: hybrid (last-touch within 1s + even-split)" with a link to docs. Transparency reduces support churn.

alex: yes, we'll add an info link and a modal that explains the math with a simple example. also include a toggle to switch to legacy even-split for one-off investigations.

rachel: signal/metrics: we need a per-tenant telemetry tag: econ_v2_method and econ_v2_sample_bucket so we can query which method produced each attribution row in the aggregator. keep cardinality low.

diego: agree. use enums for method: hybrid|even_split|legacy, and sample_bucket as small int (0-99). avoid freeform strings.

meera: visual nit: when switching to USD, show the conversion rate and timestamp used (usd_per_token @ 2026-02-10T10:00Z). avoids "why did my $ change" tickets.

alex: good point. conversion will come from billing.sku_rates API and we will surface the rate + sku id.

infra-bot: deploy started: console/feature/per-model-econ @staging (build 611.2). monitor: https://dash.redwood/s/deploys/611.2

tony: small backend ask: please include raw_token_counts in the API for each bucket so SRE can re-run attribution locally if needed. make it optional to keep payload small.

alex: will add raw_token_counts as compressed base64 csv in the response when ?debug=true. production default omits it.

rachel: test plan: compare 24h of econ-v1 vs econ-v2 for 50 random tenants and verify median per-tenant delta < 10%. if >10% we hold rollout. also check edge-case tenants with heavy fallback routing.

diego: add an integration test that simulates model chains with intentional delays to verify hybrid rule. I can draft a harness.

meera: I'll mock the UI states and verify tooltip copy vs the modal. small copy: "Estimated uses observed routing + sampled signals. Attributed is reconciled with billing credits"

alex: thanks — action items: diego write hybrid test harness; rachel define comparison job and thresholds; meera final copy; tony add debug token payload; infra add sample tags + sku rate field. I'll update the PR with changes.

infra-bot: staged deploy complete: console/feature/per-model-econ @staging (build 611.2) — all services healthy.

alex: ping me here after staging metrics look ok and we'll schedule 10% prod canary. thanks folks!
